from: hand-edited: this file is the source of this type's sections, their fields, rules and rendering. J2 builds each section's model and checks from it at load time (j2_artifact_models, j2_rules); python3 j2_template_lib.py checks every generic.json

templates.name: WebsiteSection/1 · Section
templates.description: The generic WebsiteSection/1 · Section template: the fixed layout of every website Section section, whatever the business

fields.name: id
fields.description: the section id of this workflow, as the task gives it

fields.name: anchor
fields.description: the id attribute of the section element, with the #; "" when this workflow writes page-head tags only

fields.name: implements
fields.description: the LLD section ids this builds; empty when the run has no LLD

fields.name: html
fields.description: the section's HTML only: no <html>, <head> or <body> tags; "" when this workflow writes page-head tags only

fields.name: head
fields.description: page-head tags this section needs (meta, link, style or script only); "" when it needs none

fields.name: selectors_used
fields.description: the ids and classes you used

fields.name: facts_used
fields.description: the charter facts this section shows, copied exactly

requires_one_of.message: a section must have html, or head tags when it writes only those

rules.name: the html has no <html>, <head> or <body> tags
the anchor is an id selector
the anchor points at an element in the html

rules.fail_text: {id} implements {bad}, which is not a section of the LLD
rules.name: implements points at a section id of the LLD
